title: Lipidomics identifications and quantitation
author: Jennifer Kyle
materials: Select raw files to be processed.
Double click on “alignmentresults…” (red arrow, lower left).
Choose the export directory by clicking on “Browse”.
Choose the export directory by clicking on "Browse".
Choose the export directory by clicking on "Browse".

steps.title: Initialize MSDIAL Software
steps.instruction: Launch the MSDIAL application and configure the initial data settings.

substeps.instruction: Open "MSDIAL.exe".
Under "Data type (MS/MS)", check "Centroid data".
Under "Ion mode", select the ionization mode that aligns with the files to be processed (e.g., positive or negative ion mode).
Click "Next".

steps.title: Import Data Files
steps.instruction: Load the data files into the software.

substeps.instruction: Click "Browse" to select files.
Click "Next".

steps.title: Configure Analysis Parameters
steps.instruction: Set the parameters for the analysis, either manually or by uploading a parameter file.

substeps.instruction: Select parameters per tab as required (alternatively, upload using the "parameters_POS.med" file).
Optionally fill out remaining boxes with sample type, batch, and analytical order.
Click "Browse" beside the "Project file path:" field.

steps.title: Set Ionization and Alignment Settings
steps.instruction: Configure the specific lipid subclasses and alignment settings based on the ionization mode.

substeps.instruction: In the "Analysis parameter setting" tab, click "select" for "MSP file:" and check the appropriate lipid subclasses for the chosen ionization mode (POS or NEG).
Configure the "Adduct" tab based on the ionization mode.
In the "Alignment" tab, configure settings based on the ionization mode.
In the "Alignment" tab, select "Together with Alignment" and click "Finished".

steps.title: Validate Identifications
steps.instruction: Review the aligned peaks and validate the metabolite identifications.

substeps.instruction: Click "EIC aligned spot" to view aligned peaks.
Click "Show ion table".
In the alignment table, sort by the "Metabolite name" column and then the "RT(min)" column.
Manually validate identifications by examining the MS/MS spectra.

steps.title: Curate Chromatograms
steps.instruction: Adjust and validate the integration and selection of chromatograms.

substeps.instruction: Right-click on chromatograms and choose "Table viewer for curating each chromatogram" and/or "Aligned chromatogram viewer for simultaneous curations".

steps.title: Export Results
steps.instruction: Export the processed data matrix from the software.

substeps.instruction: Click the "Export" tab.
Check "Raw data matrix (Height)".
Click "Export".
